description: Ministry of Highways - Meerigama - Kurunegala Section of Central Expressway as a National Highway
categorisation: This gazette content contains a legal order issued under Section 8 of The National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008, declaring a specific road section as a National Highway. It involves regulatory action based on existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or structural change. While a minister is named, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory function being performed, and no detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes are described.
